findings.classification: Introduced by original isolated remediation proposal
findings.title: A response transformer error can retain the loader after subsequent successful requests.
findings.trigger: A loading-enabled request uses transformResponse. The transformer throws an Error without config.
findings.cause: finishRequestLoading cannot delete the stored request when error.config is unavailable.
findings.consequence: The pending entry survives rejection. Later successful requests cannot remove that entry.
findings.baseline_result: Loading becomes false after rejection and after the next successful request.
findings.original_proposal_result: Loading remains true after rejection and after the next successful request.
findings.next_action: Restore missing-config cleanup without weakening existing cancellation and session assertions. Add DEL-23, then rerun the affected suite.
findings.closure_evidence: Updated patch identity, passing DEL-23, preserved DEL-14/DEL-19/DEL-21/DEL-22, and complete applicable suite.
findings.limits: The public API accepts AxiosRequestConfig. No inspected business caller supplies this transformer. Production occurrence remains unknown.

rejected_candidates.reason: Visibility transitions clear the timer. Rescheduling requires positive lead time. Only the retained scheduled callback bypasses the cutoff.

rejected_candidates.candidate: The timer change allows acquisition after access expiry or logout.
rejected_candidates.reason: The scheduled path retains valid-access, logout, refresh-expiry, and timeout guards.

rejected_candidates.candidate: A stale known-config cancellation clears the new session loader.
rejected_candidates.reason: Epoch synchronization clears obsolete bookkeeping. The stale guard returns before publishing loading. DEL-22 asserts the new loader remains true.

rejected_candidates.candidate: Error message loss from spreading Error is introduced by this proposal.
rejected_candidates.reason: Both compared versions spread the rejection object. The probe records null messages in both versions.

rejected_candidates.candidate: Logout permanently retains PageLoader because CLEAR does not reset loading.
rejected_candidates.reason: Routing mounts Login after token removal. Login clears loading in its mount effect.

conditional_fallback_assessment.proposed_action: Clear pending when a finishing error has no config identity.
conditional_fallback_assessment.before_change_parity: This restores the prior global cleanup behavior for non-cancel errors.
conditional_fallback_assessment.ownership_limit: Unavailable config cannot identify a request or session. A stale or silent failure can clear another current request loader.
conditional_fallback_assessment.classification: That non-cancel cleanup risk exists in the before-proposal candidate. Do not claim complete ownership isolation for unavailable identity.
conditional_fallback_assessment.cancellation_limit: The before-proposal candidate skipped cleanup for no-config cancellation. Main previously cleared loading. Keep that distinction visible.
required_controls: Known-config stale guard remains before fallback.
Pass DEL-23 and the complete applicable suite.
